newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 20.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 20.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- NATO general secretary Javier Solana reassured a Hungarian parliamentary commission that the costs of joining the NATO would not be unbearable for the country.
- The government discusses today the opportunities of opening new Hungarian and Romanian consulates in the two countries.
- State-controlled radio and television have much to do in the interest of preserving the equality in the chances of getting to knowledge, Hungtarian Academy of Sciences Chairman Ferenc Glatz said.
